one_liner: Salesforce has a broad REST/SOAP/Bulk/GraphQL API with OAuth2 and a free Developer Edition org, but its API terms require ISV Partner Program enrollment for commercial multi-customer use; vendor also offers MCP servers.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 via connected apps / external client apps (authorization code, client credentials, JWT bearer). SOAP login() uses username+password(+security token). JWT is minted by the developer.
access_notes: Developer Edition orgs have API access enabled by default and can be signed up for free. Production orgs need Enterprise+ or add-on (customer's cost). Statement in draft that trial orgs are not API-enabled is not verified by the pages.
blocker_notes: A free Developer Edition org gives working OAuth credentials, so building and testing is self-serve. But the SFDC API Terms bar Commercial Use of the APIs unless the app is enrolled in Salesforce's ISV partner program, which applies to a commercial multi-tenant toolkit.
